text.offer: Down in the sewers, where Chuk Creek runs foul, ogres have made their home - great brutes that come up at night and carry off whatever they can find. Kill six of them, and I'll never charge you for a room again. Well - almost never.
text.progress: The ogres lurk up Chuk Creek, in Ko'catan's sewers.
text.complete: Six ogres! The night watch can stop sleeping with their spears.
